title: Cosmic Tycoon
logline: Mine asteroids, build extractors, and expand your cosmic empire — watch your mineral count soar even when you look away.
visualStyle: Space-themed dark background with star field. Central asteroid in grays/browns. Extractors are small colored rectangles with oscillation animation. Sci-fi digital resource counters. Clean button panels. Cyan and gold neon accents. Floating mineral particles.
coreMechanic: Click asteroid to mine minerals. Buy auto-extractors that produce minerals per second. Upgrade click value and extractor rates. Unlock new mineral types at thresholds. Prestige system resets for Cosmic Dust permanent multipliers.
restartBehavior: Full reset including prestige bonuses on game complete restart
persistence: localStorage save every 5 seconds and on pause/destroy, with offline gains calculation on load

screens.intro: COSMIC TYCOON metallic title, floating asteroid, Click to Begin, lifetime minerals display
screens.hud: Minerals center-top (large, animated), rate + click value below, mineral type, extractors right panel, upgrades left panel, prestige bottom-center
screens.pause: PAUSED overlay with minerals, rate, prestige stats
screens.gameOver: COSMIC EMPIRE COMPLETE with celebration particles, lifetime stats, restart prompt
